column1: # Words Punjabi speakers routinely write in Gurmukhi but which are NOT
# phonetically derivable from the Punjabi phonetic rules: English spelling says
# little about English sound, so "school" would come out ਸਚੂਲ and "phone"
# ਫੋਣੇ. Typed on the Punjabi phonetic layout, the English spelling on the left
# resolves directly to the Gurmukhi form on the right, ahead of the rules and
# A hand-written draft that wants a Punjabi speaker's review. A wrong entry
# here is worse than a missing one, since it outranks everything.
# Format: english<TAB>gurmukhi   (one mapping per line; # starts a comment)
# Keep the English key lowercase. First column is matched case-insensitively.
# No "sir": on this layout it is ਸਿਰ (head), typed far more often than the title.
